fact: Benin is among the eight WAEMU countries on the BCEAO PI-SPI instant payment platform launched 30 September 2025, letting a Senegalese merchant receive money instantly from a Beninese customer.
PI-SPI is a unified regional instant payment platform covering the eight UEMOA countries.
Benin is a UEMOA member state on PI-SPI, the regional instant payment platform operated by BCEAO, with 80 participants connected on 2 April 2026.
Benin recorded cross-border e-money transfers within the UEMOA in 2024, per the BCEAO annual report on digital financial services.
Benin had 8 million intra-UEMOA cross-border transfer operations worth CFA 230 billion in 2024, an average of CFA 5,172, per the BCEAO.
